##### Project general facts

Al Mamsha by Alef Group is a car-free, fully integrated mixed-use community that weaves modern living, retail and leisure into one vibrant urban environment. Generous walkable spaces, distinguished architecture and a high-quality public realm create a lively setting designed to host local art and events. Residential buildings rising to nine floors offer studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with large, luxurious duplexes with contemporary designs.

Residents find swimming pools, state-of-the-art gyms, health clubs and family entertainment and leisure centres right on their doorstep, along with a children's waterpark, water features and safe play areas. Dedicated cycling and jogging tracks and pocket parks encourage an active lifestyle, while a sprawling ground-level retail promenade, outdoor cafes and restaurants around a community square bring shopping and dining within easy walking distance.

Apartments are spacious, with contemporary layouts created for comfortable family living and plenty of natural light. Several access points lead directly to basement parking, and the community is looked after by a professional management agency. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with white goods including a refrigerator, a washing machine and an oven, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Muwaileh is a fast-growing residential district of Sharjah, set beside University City and close to the Aljada master community. Modern apartment buildings, schools, clinics, supermarkets and neighbourhood retail make it a practical, family-friendly area, while universities and research institutions nearby give it a lively, youthful atmosphere throughout the academic year.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road and University City Road connect residents with Sharjah city centre, Dubai and the northern emirates. University City and Sahara Centre are a short drive away, Sharjah International Airport and the Al Majaz Waterfront are close by, and Dubai International Airport, Deira and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance.

Sharjah allows property ownership for international buyers in designated communities and offers some of the most accessible prices in the UAE. Large master-planned communities with walkable streets, retail and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and strong road links to Dubai underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
